title: Credo (Lassus, Missa Entre vous filles)
desc: Orlande de Lassus, Missa Entre vous filles, Credo. 5 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor 1, Tenor 2, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
